Jim introduces the Fire and Ice Bushcrafter tent.
He describes the tent's materials and construction.
He highlights its intended use as a two-man four-season tent.
He showcases the tent's large screen front door.
He points out the rear vent mesh and its protected flap for weather resistance.

He explains the provided pegs and tie-out ropes.
He demonstrates different setup options using poles, ridgelines, and trekking poles.
He discusses the tent's flap design and center pull-outs for interior space.
